prompt:
Animate the APPROVED LARK pixel sprite from reference1, in the exact ONE facing of reference2. Reference1 is owner-approved appearance; no redesign or aging/gender changes. This is a production game-animation source sheet, not a concept. EXACTLY SIX EQUAL COLUMNS BY THREE EQUAL ROWS, 18 full-body sprites. Transparent background, no checkerboard, borders, labels, floor, cast shadow or scenery. Every cell same camera/body scale, centered pelvis and shared planted-foot baseline around92% of cell. Generous clear transparent gutters; all hair, instrument, hands and boots fully inside cell without edge cropping or neighbours touching. Crisp square pixel clusters like native96x96 guide, body about72 logical pixels tall, enlarged nearest-neighbour, limited warm olive/brown/charcoal palette, no smooth illustration/antialiasing. LARK: clean-shaven ANDROGYNOUS adult human songkeeper with friendly curious face, medium grey-brown loose hair at ears and small HALF-UP BUN at back. Practical charcoal tunic/trousers, layered patched muted olive and brown ragged travelling shawl/knee-length cloak, hood DOWN, worn lace-up brown boots. Simple leather cross-body carrying straps, ordinary front belt buckle. Bare EMPTY hands. Not a wizard, jester, warrior, child, bearded man or glamorous princess. ONE weathered pear-shaped wooden stringed instrument always STRAPPED diagonally ON BACK, never held or put on chest: neck over anatomical RIGHT shoulder, pear body toward anatomical LEFT lower back. Instrument headstock stops at ear-level BELOW hair crown so head remains highest point. Song-paper satchel at anatomical LEFT hip, scroll tube at anatomical RIGHT hip. Sides stay exact, no whole-body mirroring, no duplicate instrument or invented weapons. All clothing colors, patches, face/hair, body proportions and instrument shape CONSISTENT THROUGH18POSES. Entire sheet ONE SAME FACING, no rotation during animation. Row1 six IDLE poses: quiet breathing via tiny shoulder/chest motion, slight cloth movement, no wandering/hand gesture, both feet planted unchanged, head stable. Row2 six REAL WALK poses, clear alternating leg cycle IN PLACE: col1 LEFT foot forward contact, col2 left-leg weight/down, col3 RIGHT foot passing forward beside left support, col4 RIGHT foot forward contact, col5 right-leg weight/down, col6 LEFT foot passing forward beside right support. IMPORTANT half-cycle2 uses OPPOSITE lead leg from half-cycle1; do not repeat same leg. Modest arm counter-swing, subtle cloak hem/paper sway, instrument securely follows torso, no huge bob/crouch or lateral drift. Both boots identifiable, no leg merges. Row3 six TALK poses: rest, small nod, empty hand begins rise, modest open-palm explanation, friendly emphasis, hand begins settling. Feet absolutely planted; speaking mouth only where face visible, rear views have small shoulder/hand gesture. Instrument stays strapped, never played/gripped/moved to front. Head/face stays same, no extra limbs or props. Idle/talk will play forward and reverse; walk loops. Strict alpha0 outside silhouettes, opaque clothes/skin. Do not crop any frame.
ONE FACING FOR ALL18 POSES: DIRECT BACK, face and front buckle HIDDEN. Half-up hair bun. Back of patched travelling cloak. Instrument diagonal on BACK: neck rises toward IMAGE RIGHT shoulder, pear body toward IMAGE LEFT lower back. Satchel/papers anatomical LEFT=IMAGE LEFT, scroll-tube anatomical RIGHT=IMAGE RIGHT.
